name: XlCommentDisplayMode
description: Specifies the way that cells display comments and comment indicators.

constants.name: xlNoIndicator
constants.description: Display neither the comment nor the comment indicator at any time.

constants.name: xlCommentIndicatorOnly
constants.description: Display comment indicator only. Display comment when mouse pointer is moved over cell.

constants.name: xlCommentAndIndicator
constants.description: Display comment and indicator at all times.
